name: Stunt Paradise 2
description:
About This Game

Welcome to Stunt Paradise 2 — the arcade world where speed and chaos rule the road! This is the place where adrenaline spikes, explosions roar at every corner, and your driving skills are always on the edge.

Get ready for brand-new levels packed with unpredictable traps: lasers, buzzsaws, mines, explosives, and many other deadly surprises that turn every run into a true challenge. Jump across gaps, flip through the air, soar over ramps, and smash through obstacles — all in the rhythm of pure arcade madness!

The game now features a major visual upgrade: detailed environments, flashy effects, and modern shaders that make every jump, every explosion, and every crash more spectacular than ever. It’s easy to pick up but hard to master — simple yet deep gameplay that challenges even the most skilled drivers.

Stunt Paradise 2 delivers a wide selection of cars, dynamic levels, and an endless rush of adrenaline. It’s the ultimate game for those who dare to risk, laugh at their own failures, and enjoy non-stop action!

Key Features:

  • New traps and mechanics: lasers, buzzsaws, explosives, and more

  • Improved graphics with modern effects and detailed environments

  • Checkpoint system for smoother progression

  • Extreme stunts and explosive arcade action

  • Driving rock composed by a professional guitarist

  • A wide variety of cars for every playstyle


Step on the gas and experience pure chaos on wheels in Stunt Paradise 2!
short_desc: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!
